dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Uniform linear narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a sharp point at the fluke junction.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Visible symmetrical lateral protrusions in the anterior third of the body consistent with the positioning of pectoral fins.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with localized grey shading observed at the blowhole and along the lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the white dorsal field and the darker grey visible along the body's peripheral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast circular aperture at the blowhole site on the anterior dorsal plane.
